editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FXCM is one of the oldest retail forex brokers (since 1999), scoring 6.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. Currently regulated by FCA, ASIC, CySEC, and FSCA — but carries historical baggage from its 2017 NFA fine and US licence loss. Active Trader pricing from 0.2 pips is competitive, TradingView integration is a genuine plus, and ZuluTrade partnership adds copy trading. The 77% loss rate and past regulatory issues lower the trust score. Best for experienced traders who value platform features over brand reputation.
